records.description: Binance announced XRP for progressive phase-one withdrawals 06:00-09:00 UTC, but the public status page rechecked at 06:40 displayed last-updated 2026-10-30 01:00 (timezone undisclosed) and No Data.
records.evidence: Official announcement plus stale status page; no successful customer XRP withdrawal observed.

records.description: XRP Insights, Maketo and SoSoValue use different fund universes and methods; XRP holdings deltas cannot be equated to direct cash subscriptions.
records.evidence: XRP Insights excludes GXRP flows and includes BITW; Maketo tracks five tickers; SoSoValue reports a different per-fund universe.

records.description: XRP open-interest provider observations range from approximately $749M to $2.81B because venue and contract universes differ; no unified total is justified.
records.evidence: Kodexius seven contracts, JustScreener nine exchanges, Kairo 13 venues, TRdesk 26 exchanges including CME and CoinGlass broad dashboard.

records.description: Coinbase Q3 2026 10-Q does not separately identify XRP collateral; other crypto assets are aggregated and customer collateral not recognized is not asset-level broken out.
records.evidence: SEC Q3 10-Q contains no XRP text hit; recognized other crypto collateral $9.903M; customer crypto collateral not recognized $2.804B; derivatives collateral table names BTC and ETH.

records.description: Two trackers show RLUSD near $707M on XRPL, but total stablecoin supply differs and the reported seven-day contraction has not been reconciled to mint, burn or bridge transactions.
records.evidence: DefiLlama and stables.cool snapshots; USDC on XRPL is about $4.8M in the stables.cool observation.

records.description: SBI's JPYSC, SMFG, BlackRock/Startale and Open Standard/OUSD initiatives do not establish XRP routing or a coordinated XRP strategy.
records.evidence: Official announcements describe stablecoin, tokenized-MMF and interoperability exploration without naming Ripple or XRP in those initiatives.
